title: The 3 Best Car Seats Under $150
metaDescription: Our 3 picks for car seats under $150, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at car seats under $150 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Evenflo LiteMax 35 Infant Car Seat
products.blurb: Key specs: Fits infants 4 to 35 pounds, 8.7-pound carrier, one of the lightest available, Belt lock-off for base-free installation.
strengths: Meets the same FMVSS 213 federal safety standard as seats costing twice as much
Lightweight shell makes daily carrying noticeably easier than heavier budget alternatives
limitations: Fewer premium comfort features and a less padded insert than pricier infant seats
LATCH connectors on the base are reported as harder to attach than Chicco's
Fewer stroller travel-system pairings than the pricier Chicco KeyFit 35
features: 8.7-pound carrier, one of the lightest available

products.name: Evenflo Sonus Convertible Car Seat
strengths: Light and easy to move between cars
Budget price for a convertible seat
Compact enough for smaller back seats
limitations: Less legroom rear-facing than extended-legroom seats

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
